description.content:
# Standard library

Templates every Fos account can use, offline: write `` [ ] `Plan a trip` `` in any node to start one. Edit them here to propose a change; members vote on proposals and the library merges what enough of them approve.
Set the items aside by hand
Fallbacks that work with no peer: the person who did it by hand records it here. Edit the labels to propose better ones; add a row to offer a fallback for another kind of requirement.
